summary: Ship the vlan package on the ISO so nex-core-local's offline dependencies resolve, and gate that closure in installer/check.sh. API impact: none.

guide.reason: The documented installation steps and operator choices are unchanged; this restores the install they already describe.

api.reason: Installation media package closure only. No Controller/Core route, command, event or stream is added or changed, and no caller or agent contract is touched.

roadmap.reason: A build-input defect fix; no phase scope or ordering changes.

state.reason: Installation media contents only. No durable Controller or pool-scoped record is created, read or changed.

verification.method: bash installer/check.sh passed with vlan present and failed with 'nex-core-local depends on packages the ISO repo never downloads: [\'vlan\']' when the entry was removed, on 2026-09-21. The dependency mismatch was traced to installer/build.sh resolving the offline closure from installer/packages.txt before appending nex-core-local, and to packaging/core-local/build-inside.sh adding vlan without a matching media entry. A rebuilt ISO and a disposable-lab installation are remaining evidence; no ISO was built or installed for this change.
